site: Example bench (Newport XPS, example overlay only)
notes: Example values only, not a device specification: the travel range of a Newport XPS stage is read from the controller configuration at connection time (PositionerUserTravelLimitsGet, newportxps/newportxps.py:250-253) and depends on the installed stage. Replace the bounds with the travel range of the installed stage in controller user units.

position.reason: example only: replace with the absolute travel range of the installed stage in controller user units

offset.reason: example only: replace with the largest permitted relative step of the installed stage in controller user units
